data.name: Wyrm Tears

entries: They are not merely stones. They are echos of dragons made manifest upon the world where the flame of their will never truly die.

A Wyrm Tear is more than a relic: it is a living fragment of a dragon's essence bound within a crystallized heart. Though these items are known by many names in legend-Dragonheart Shards, Scalesoul Gems, Wyrm Tears-there is only one truth: to wield a Wyrm Tear is to step onto the path of the Dragoons, champions reborn from a legacy steeped in fire, blood, and wings of glory.

These legendary artifacts were not forged but wakened, formed at the moment of a dragon's transcendent death. Each spirit bears the mind, power, and elemental fury of the dragon that once reigned in the skies or seas, slumbering until it finds a mortal deemed worthy of its burden.

A celestial Dragoon, adorned in radiant azure armor and wielding a mystical bow, stands poised amidst the heavens—her ethereal wings glowing with divine energy, evoking the legendary power of a Selenite Wyrm Tear.

entries.title: A dragoon attuned to a Selenite Wyrm Tear, in Dragoon Form

entries: The power to wield a Wyrm Tear is not claimed—it is earned. The spirit within is intelligent, selective, and often silent, watching from behind shimmering facets for a spark it recognizes: strength, resolve, compassion, rage—whatever virtue or vice once defined the dragon in life.

Once bonded, the Wyrm Tear reshapes its bearer, imbuing them with power to rival the powerful wyrms. Each Wyrm Tear manifests different abilities depending on the type of dragon within—be it flame-wreathed Red, ice-cold White, tempestuous Blue, or any of the primal breeds. These powers grow as the bearer deepens their bond with the spirit, culminating in a transformation that fuses mortal and dragonkind: the awe-inspiring Dragoon.

The stones pulse with latent magic. When brought near each other, they glow with intense radiance, resonating with shared draconic memory—an echo of a forgotten war. It is perhaps for this reason that Dragoons seem to be drawn to each other, to fulfill whatever purpose they are needed for next.

entries.name: Wyrm Tears Features
entries: A Wyrm Tear may not be destroyed. Another creature may not receive the benefits of the Wyrm Tear unless the dragon's soul finds them worthy. If two Wyrm Tears are within 15 feet of each other, they shine brightly like beacons.

The depth of the bond between a Wyrm Tear and its master determines the state of the item. A Wyrm Tear in its {@i Slumbering} state has certain base properties, and it gains additional properties when it enters the {@i Stirring}, {@i Wakened} or {@i Ascendant} state.

entries.caption: Wyrm Tear States
rows: {@book Spirit Points|EAWyrmTears|0|spirit points}, {@book Dragoon Form|EAWyrmTears|0|dragoon form}, {@book Dragoon Spellcasting|EAWyrmTears|0|dragoon spellcasting} (cantrips)
Dragoon Form (+1 attack/dmg), Dragoon Spellcasting (1st-2nd lvl. spells)
{@book Elemental Affinity|EAWyrmTears|0|elemental affinity}, Dragoon Spellcasting (3rd lvl. spells)
{@book Elemental Burst|EAWyrmTears|0|elemental burst}, Dragoon Spellcasting (4th lvl. spells)

entries.name: Spirit Points
entries: While attuned to a Wyrm Tear, you gain a pool of spirit points according to the Spirit Points column of the Wyrm Tear table. You can expend a number of spirit points to activate various Dragoon abilities. You can't reduce your spirit points total to less than 0, and you regain all spent spirit points when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Dragoon Form
entries: While attuned to a Wyrm Tear, if you have a minimum of 1 spirit points stored you may activate the dragoon form as a bonus action, projecting the soul of the dragon as a set of armor and wings. Any turn spent in Dragoon Form will consume 1 spirit point. The form lasts for 1 minute, or until your spirit point count is 0, at which point you return to normal. You also lose the form when you become unconscious and you can also choose to end the form voluntarily (no action).
While in Dragoon Form, you gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a +1 bonus to your AC with your dragoon armor.
You gain a hover speed of 30 feet, but you cannot rise more than 10 feet of the ground.

entries: When bearing a {@i Stirring} Wyrm Tear, your Dragoon Form gains an additional benefit:

items: Your weapon attacks gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls.

entries.name: Dragoon Spellcasting
entries: You may also call upon your Wyrm Tear to evoke spells themed by their element. Casting a leveled spell can only be done while in Dragoon Form.
The number of spirit points you need to spend for each spell level is shown in the Dragoon Spells table.
The Wyrm Tear state determines the maximum-level spell you can cast. Even though you might have enough points to cast a level above this maximum, you can't do so:

items: A {@i Slumbering} Wyrm Tear will allow you to cast cantrips.
A {@i Stirring} Wyrm Tear will allow you to cast 1st-2nd level spells.
An {@i Wakened} Wyrm Tear will allow you to cast 3rd level spells.
An {@i Asceneded} Wyrm Tear will allow you to cast 4th level spells.

entries.name: Spellcasting Ability
entries: Constitution is your spellcasting ability for your dragoon spells, since your magic is born from your inner strength to evoke the dragon's power. You use your Constitution whenever a spell refers to your spellcasting ability. In addition, you use your Constitution modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a dragoon spell you cast and when making an attack roll with one.

entries.name: Spellcasting Focus
entries: Your Dragoon Form itself can be used as a spellcasting focus. You must have at least one free hand to cast spells that require somatic or material components.

entries.name: Elemental Affinity
entries: With a deepened attunement to the soul that resets inside your Wyrm Tear, you gain an affinity with its element. You learn to understand Draconic and the language of its element, and gain resistances and vulnerabilities while in Dragoon Form according to it.

entries.name: Elemental Burst
entries: At the apex of your bond with the spirit, you can unleash an elemental surge when you hit a creature with a weapon attack or a spell, spending a number of spirit points, to deal additional elemental damage to the creature. The extra damage type depends on your Wyrm Tear.

entries.name: Wyrm Tears Descriptions
entries: Wyrm tears are presented here in alphabetical order.

itemEntry.name: Wyrm Tear Intro
entriesTemplate: A gem-like round stone pulsing with dragon energy. Resonates with chosen warriors, unlocking the ancient power of the Dragoons.

itemEntry.name: Slumbering Wyrm Tear
entriesTemplate: While attuned to this item, you gain the following benefits:

entriesTemplate.name: Slumbering
entries: When your wyrm tear is in an slumbering state, you gain the following properties:

items.name: Spirit Points
entries: You gain a pool of 3 spirit points. You regain all spent spirit points at the end of a long rest.

items.name: Dragoon Spellcasting
entries: You learn a selection of cantrips and spells themed to the dragon element according to the Dragoon Spells table.

items: You can cast cantrips freely, while you can cast leveled spells only by spending a number of spirit points while in Dragoon Form.
You can use your Dragoon Form as a spellcasting focus, but you must have at least one free hand to cast spells that require somatic or material components.
Constitution is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

items.name: Dragoon Form.
entries: You can enter Dragoon Form as a bonus action if you have at least 1 spirit point. You expend 1 spirit point at the start of each of your turns. While in Dragoon Form, which lasts for 1 minute or until you end it (no action required), fall {@condition unconscious}, or have 0 spirit points, you gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a +1 bonus to AC.
You gain a hover speed of 30 feet. You can't rise more than 10 feet above the ground.

entriesTemplate.name: Stirring
entries: When your wyrm tear reaches the stirring state, you gain the following properties:

items: Your spirit point pool expands to 6.
The max level of spell you can cast goes up to 2nd level.
When in Dragoon Form, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with weapon attacks.

entriesTemplate.name: Wakened
entries: When your wyrm tear reaches the wakened state, you gain the following properties:

items: Your spirit point pool expands to 17.
The max level of spell you can cast goes up to 3rd level.

entriesTemplate.name: Ascendant
entries: When your wyrm tear reaches the ascendant state, you gain the following properties:

items: Your spirit point pool expands to 27.
The max level of spell you can cast goes up to 4th level.

item.name: Wyrm Tear
entries: A gem-like round stone pulsing with dragon energy. Resonates with chosen warriors, unlocking the ancient power of the Dragoons.
Multiple variations of this item exist, as listed below:

item.name: Garnet Wyrm Tear
entries: {#itemEntry Wyrm Tear Intro|EAWyrmTears}

entries.name: Garnet Wyrm Spirit
entries: {@i This spirit was born of chaotic fire, and the searing heat that resides within it embodies the user completely.}
{@b Dragon Category:} Red or Gold dragon souls fit in this category.
Multiple variations of this item exist, as listed below:

item.name: Aquamarine Wyrm Tear
entries: {#itemEntry Wyrm Tear Intro|EAWyrmTears}

entries.name: Aquamarine Wyrm Spirit
entries: {@i Both the top of the iced mountains and the depths of the ocean are cold and mysterious, and this spirit harnesses the harsh power of nature in the form of water.}
{@b Dragon Category:} White or Silver dragon souls fit into this category.
Multiple variations of this item exist, as listed below:

item.name: Amethyst Wyrm Tear
entries: {#itemEntry Wyrm Tear Intro|EAWyrmTears}

entries.name: Amethyst Wyrm Spirit
entries: {@i It is said that this spirit has been born from a lightning bolt—coalescing in immense power in the most raw form.}
{@b Dragon Category:} Blue or Bronze dragon souls fit in this category.
Multiple variations of this item exist, as listed below:

item.name: Amber Wyrm Tear
entries: {#itemEntry Wyrm Tear Intro|EAWyrmTears}

entries.name: Amber Wyrm Spirit
entries: {@i This spirit is of the raw essence of the soil and the acids that are within it. Strong and stolid, the earth conceals its corrosive nature.}
{@b Dragon Category:} Black or Copper dragon souls fit in this category.
Multiple variations of this item exist, as listed below:

item.name: Peridot Wyrm Tear
entries: {#itemEntry Wyrm Tear Intro|EAWyrmTears}

entries.name: Peridot Wyrm Spirit
entries: {@i This spirit is the embodiment of wind and poison. While seemingly gentle, underestimating a strong gust can be as deadly as the poison.}
{@b Dragon Category:} Green or Brass dragon souls fit in this category.
Multiple variations of this item exist, as listed below:

item.name: Onyx Wyrm Tear
entries: {#itemEntry Wyrm Tear Intro|EAWyrmTears}

entries.name: Onyx Wyrm Spirit
entries: {@i This spirit is of a dragon reborn of darkness and far from other life, now an unded machine of destruction that seeks to irradicate life as its opposed nature.}
{@b Dragon Category:} Shadow or Topaz dragon souls fit in this category.

rows: {@spell wrathful smite}, {@spell grip of the dead|kibblestasty:cc}

entries: Multiple variations of this item exist, as listed below:

item.name: Selenite Wyrm Tear
entries: {#itemEntry Wyrm Tear Intro|EAWyrmTears}

entries.name: Selenite Wyrm Spirit
entries: {@i Born of purest light, this spirit radiates with divine power—capable of healing the wounded and smiting the darkness that seeks to consume all life.}
{@b Dragon Category:} Moonstone or Crystal dragon souls fit in this category.
Multiple variations of this item exist, as listed below:
{#itemEntry Slumbering Wyrm Tear|EAWyrmTears}

items.name: Fire Tongued
entries: You learn to understand {@language Draconic} and {@language Primordial|phb|Ignan (Primordial)}.
While in Dragoon Form, you become resistant to fire damage, and vulnerable to cold damage.

items.name: Flame Burst
entries: While in Dragoon Form, when you hit a creature with a weapon attack you may spend 3 spirit points to unleash an explosion of flames upon the target, in addition to the weapon's damage.
Alternatively, when you cast a spell that deals damage to a creature you may spend 3 spirit points to apply the same effect to one creature hit by the spell.
The target takes an immediate extra {@dice 2d6} fire damage.
{#itemEntry Slumbering Wyrm Tear|EAWyrmTears}

items.name: Icicle Tongue
entries: You learn to understand {@language Draconic} and {@language Primordial|phb|Aquan (Primordial)}.
While in Dragoon Form, you become resistant to cold damage, and vulnerable to fire damage.

items.name: Ice Burst
entries: While in Dragoon Form, when you hit a creature with a weapon attack you may spend 3 spirit points to unleash a spike of ice upon the target, in addition to the weapon's damage.
Alternatively, when you cast a spell that deals damage to a creature you may spend 3 spirit points to apply the same effect to one creature hit by the spell.
The target takes an immediate extra {@dice 2d6} cold damage.
{#itemEntry Slumbering Wyrm Tear|EAWyrmTears}

items.name: Lightning Words
entries: You learn to understand {@language Draconic} and {@language Primordial|phb|Fulman (Primordial)}.
While in Dragoon Form, you become resistant to lightning and thunder damage, and vulnerable to acid and poison damage.

items.name: Electric Burst
entries: While in Dragoon Form, when you hit a creature with a weapon attack you may spend 3 spirit points to unleash a bolt of thunderous lightning upon the target, in addition to the weapon's damage.
Alternatively, when you cast a spell that deals damage to a creature you may spend 3 spirit points to apply the same effect to one creature hit by the spell.
The target takes an immediate extra {@dice 1d6} lightning + {@dice 1d6} thunder damage.
{#itemEntry Slumbering Wyrm Tear|EAWyrmTears}

items.name: Earthen Voice
entries: You learn to understand {@language Draconic} and {@language Primordial|phb|Terran (Primordial)}.
While in Dragoon Form, you become resistant to acid and earth (magical slashing or bludgeoning from earth effects) damage, and vulnerable to poison and thunder damage.

items.name: Boulder Burst
entries: While in Dragoon Form, when you hit a creature with a weapon attack you may spend 3 spirit points to unleash an acidic boulder upon the target, in addition to the weapon's damage.
Alternatively, when you cast a spell that deals damage to a creature you may spend 3 spirit points to apply the same effect to one creature hit by the spell.
The target takes an immediate extra {@dice 1d6} acid + {@dice 1d6} magical bludgeoning damage.

While in Dragoon Form, you become resistant to poison and wind (magical slashing or bludgeoning from wind effects) damage, and vulnerable to acid and lightning damage.

The target takes an immediate extra {@dice 2d6} radiant damage.
